h1: B2 Nakhon Si Thammarat Premier Hotel — a Tha Wang city boutique where fresh rooms and price are the draw
intro: If you want a downtown Nakhon Si Thammarat stay with rooms that look new, feel clean and come at an easy price, B2 Nakhon Si Thammarat Premier Hotel is one of the first names that comes up · It's part of the B2 chain that Thai travellers know well, set on Sriprad Road in the Tha Wang district right in the city centre · 118 modern earth-tone rooms, free parking, free Wi-Fi, a restaurant and a 24-hour front desk — from around ฿650/night · Real guest reviews agree on the location, clean rooms and value, with the trade-offs being a fairly firm mattress and parking that fills up fast on some nights.

Bathroom at B2 Nakhon Si Thammarat Premier Hotel with a rain shower, clean and simple

body.html: B2 Nakhon Si Thammarat Premier Hotel is one of the B2 chain's properties — a budget-to-boutique brand with hotels across many Thai provinces · This Nakhon Si Thammarat branch is a Premier-tier property on Sriprad Road in Tha Wang, right in the city centre · It leans on fresh-looking rooms, clean simple design and an accessible price rather than full-service luxury · There are 118 rooms, free parking, a restaurant, meeting rooms and a 24-hour front desk — handy for both tourists and people here for work.

Rooms are done in a modern earth-tone style that feels warm and simple, ranging from a twin-bed Superior and a large-bed Deluxe Premier to a Triple that sleeps three at no extra cost · What guests mention often is that rooms are more spacious than expected at this price, clean, fresh-looking, and fitted with a rain shower · Every room has air-con, a fridge, TV and Wi-Fi · The trade-off reviews mention consistently is that the mattress and pillows are on the firm side for some — if you have a sensitive back, plan ahead or ask for an extra pillow.
"Clean, fresh-looking room, polite staff, plenty of free parking, and an easy price — it's central, you can walk to Tha Wang market and the City Pillar Shrine. Great value for the rate."

Location is the hotel's highest score (reviews rate it around 9.1) · It's in the central Tha Wang district, near the Nakhon Si Thammarat City Pillar Shrine, Tha Wang market and the city's Southern curry-rice shops · Wat Phra Mahathat Woramahawihan and the old town are a short drive away · For self-drivers the free parking is a genuine plus, though on busy nights it can fill up and leave you parking on the street · The 24-hour front desk and central location make it convenient for sightseeing, official travel, or as a stopover before heading on to Khanom, Sichon or Khiriwong.

Staff service draws mostly positive notes for being friendly and helpful (service scores around 8.6) · Breakfast is included in several packages and guests say it's fair for the price — not fancy, but filling and with some local dishes mixed in · What earns B2 its 8.8 overall from 1,054 reviews is consistency on cleanliness and value rather than luxury · A minority of reviews mention finding an insect in the room or staff still learning the ropes — a small share of voices, but worth knowing.

To be honest, per real guest sentiment: B2 Nakhon Si Thammarat is a budget-friendly boutique that does its job well — not a full-facility luxury hotel · There's no pool or gym like the bigger hotels, and the firm mattress is the most common complaint · Parking is free but fills up fast on busy nights, and there's a key-card deposit system that some find fiddly · Guests who are disappointed usually expected a full 4-star standard, while those who understand they're booking a clean, well-priced city boutique tend to be satisfied.

In short, if you want a downtown Nakhon Si Thammarat stay with fresh, clean rooms, a central Tha Wang location, free parking and an easy price — B2 Premier delivers, on a comfortable budget · Its 8.8 score from 1,054 Trip.com reviews captures it accurately: "clean rooms, good location, good value" · It works well both as a central base for exploring the city and as a stopover before trips around the province.

A tip from following the reviews here: if you're particular about the bed, ask for an extra pillow or mattress topper at check-in, since the firm mattress is the most-mentioned issue · If you're driving, try to arrive at the hotel not too late in the evening, as the free parking can fill up on some nights · And don't skip a walk to Tha Wang market and the nearby Southern curry-rice shops — the food locals actually eat.

honestSummary: B2 Nakhon Si Thammarat Premier is a strong pick for travellers who want a fresh, clean, central and well-priced city stay in downtown Nakhon Si Thammarat — Tha Wang district near the City Pillar Shrine and market, with free parking and a 24-hour front desk · But understand it's a budget-friendly boutique with no pool or gym, and a fairly firm mattress.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — B2 Nakhon Si Thammarat Premier Hotel

faq.q: Where is B2 Nakhon Si Thammarat Premier Hotel, and what's nearby?
faq.a: B2 Nakhon Si Thammarat Premier Hotel is at 1584/23 Sriprad Road, Tha Wang, in downtown Nakhon Si Thammarat · It's about a 5-minute drive to the City Pillar Shrine and Tha Wang market · Wat Phra Mahathat Woramahawihan and the old town are about a 10-minute drive, the airport (NST) is roughly 20 minutes, and Khiriwong / Lan Saka about 40 minutes.

faq.q: How much does B2 Nakhon Si Thammarat Premier Hotel cost, and what rooms are available?
faq.a: Rates start at around ฿650/night for a Superior Room · A Deluxe Premier runs about ฿750, a Luxury Triple (sleeps three) around ฿950, and a Suite around ฿1,100 · Prices vary by date and platform — compare Agoda, Booking and Trip.com before booking.

faq.q: Are the rooms at B2 Nakhon Si Thammarat Premier Hotel clean? What are they like?
faq.a: Rooms are done in a modern earth-tone style and most reviews praise them as clean, fresh-looking and more spacious than expected for the price, with a rain shower, air-con, fridge, TV and free Wi-Fi · The commonly-mentioned caveat is a firm mattress and pillows — if that matters, ask for an extra pillow or topper.

faq.q: Does B2 Nakhon Si Thammarat Premier Hotel have parking and breakfast?
faq.a: Yes — free parking suits self-drivers, though on busy nights it can fill up and leave you parking on the street · Breakfast is included in several packages (check when booking) · There's a restaurant, meeting rooms and a 24-hour front desk, but no pool or gym.

faq.q: Who is B2 Nakhon Si Thammarat Premier Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's ideal for travellers who want a fresh, clean, central and well-priced stay in downtown Nakhon Si Thammarat · Good for city sightseeing, official or business travel, and self-drivers who want free parking · It's a handy base before continuing to Khanom, Sichon or Khiriwong · It's not for those who mainly want a pool, gym or a soft bed.

faq.q: What is B2 Nakhon Si Thammarat Premier Hotel's review score?
faq.a: The overall score is 8.8 from 1,054 reviews on Trip.com · Its highest mark is location (around 9.1), followed by cleanliness (around 8.9) and value (around 8.8) · Reviews sum it up as "clean rooms, good location, good value", with trade-offs being a firm mattress and no pool or gym.
